en.title: From first consultation to lasting results
en.subtitle: A proven 4-phase system that transforms how you eat, feel, and live

phases.title: Discovery & Assessment
phases.description: Deep-dive consultation covering health history, lifestyle habits, food preferences, and goals. InBody scan reveals your starting composition.

phases.title: Foundation Building
phases.description: Establish core eating patterns, portion strategies, and meal timing. Learn to navigate real-world situations while tracking progress.

phases.title: Optimization & Refinement
phases.description: Fine-tune your approach based on results. Address plateaus, adjust for lifestyle changes, introduce advanced strategies.

phases.title: Independence & Maintenance
phases.description: Transition to self-management with confidence. Quarterly check-ins ensure you stay on track long-term.

guarantee.title: Our Commitment
guarantee.text: If you follow the plan and don't see measurable progress in 8 weeks, we'll work with you for free until you do.
